loadout.ui.help.title: Help
loadout.ui.help.restore.body: When you switch to a loadout, its bound Deep-Slumber setup (cultivate line and phantom factors) is restored. Press the hotkey of the loadout you're already wearing to restore it again. Only works in Season 3. In other seasons nothing is restored, but your bindings are kept.
loadout.ui.help.bindCurrent: saves the Deep-Slumber you're using now (cultivate line and phantom factors) onto the loadout you're wearing.
loadout.ui.help.copyHere: copies the loadout you're wearing into that row: gear, modules, skills, talents, Battle Imagines and its binding.
loadout.ui.help.clear: removes the binding (the loadout itself stays).
